name: Shigure Ogasawara
source:
Shigure is the sole heir to Ogasawara Developments, the largest real estate group in the empire and operator of countless resort destinations. Groomed from infancy to eventually take control of the company, her entire personality has been cultivated for industrial success, even twisting simple hobbies like watching the rain into tools for capital growth. Between her wealth, intellect, and national celebrity status as a TV presenter, Shigure is a very dangerous woman to cross.
